queries: WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS tot FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_player_count, AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / s.tot) AS avg_fraction_of_total, AVG(c.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: A college's player count is the number of distinct player_id values in player_college. A player with several rows for the same college counts once.
Rows with a NULL college_id form a single group, which GROUP BY does by default. That group is included among the colleges when computing the all-college average and the total.
The 'average across all colleges' is the unweighted mean of the per-college counts. The 'total of all colleges' counts' is the sum of those counts.

alternatives.interpretation: Player count means the number of player_college rows per college (a player with several rows for one college counts more than once).
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS tot FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_player_count, AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / s.tot) AS avg_fraction_of_total, AVG(c.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: A college's player count is the number of distinct player_id values, since player_college has one row per player, college and year. The total of all colleges' counts is the sum of these distinct counts.
Rows with a NULL college_id form one group and count as one college when averaging across all colleges. GROUP BY already puts NULLs in a single group.

alternatives.interpretation: Player count is the number of player_college rows per college, so a player with several years at one college is counted several times.

assumptions.assumption: A college's player count is the number of distinct player_id values in player_color rows for that college_id (a player with several years at the same college counts once). Rows with NULL college_id form one group via GROUP BY.
The all-college average is the mean of the per-college counts (including the NULL group), and the total is the sum of those counts.
